slides.narration: n8n is a workflow-automation platform that connects hundreds of apps and AI models into automated pipelines using a visual, node-based editor. You can self-host it for free or use their paid cloud. There's a free tier to start.

slides.title: What's cool for NCW
lines: Educators: auto-file incoming permission slips, or summarize and route parent emails to the right staff
SMB owners: connect your form, spreadsheet, and email so new leads are logged and followed up automatically
Community leaders: automate volunteer reminders and post-event thank-you messages
slides.narration: Here's what's cool for our valley. Educators can auto-file incoming permission slips, or summarize and route parent emails to the right staff; SMB owners can connect your form, spreadsheet, and email so new leads are logged and followed up automatically; Community leaders can automate volunteer reminders and post-event thank-you messages.

slides.title: The rules — the AiGovOps way
lines: A human on the trigger — you read it before it goes out
Keep the receipts — save your prompt and the answer
Mind the data cost of “free” — no student records, IEPs, or private details in a free tool
slides.narration: Now the rules, the AiGovOps way. Keep a human on the trigger: you read it before it goes out. Keep the receipts: save your prompt and the answer. And mind the data cost of free — never paste student records, an I-E-P, or a customer's private details into a free tool, because free tools learn from what you type.
